p1: [low, ominous] Thirty-nine years ago this week, a man in a rubber mask hijacked TV in Chicago. [whispers] He was never caught.
[low] Sunday night, nineteen eighty-seven. The sports news is live on W-G-N. [low, tense] Then the screen goes black.
[low, ominous] A man in a mask appears. Swaying. No voice. [whispers] Just a loud buzz.
[low, tense] Engineers cut him off. The anchor says: [low] if you're wondering what happened... so am I.
[low] Two hours later, another channel. A Doctor Who rerun.
[low, tense] The picture cuts out. He's back. [whispers] And this time... you can hear him.
[low, ominous] A distorted voice. Laughing. Humming. For about a minute and a half.
[low, slow] Then, on its own... [whispers] the signal vanished.
[low] The F-C-C and the F-B-I investigated.
[low, slow] Nobody was ever identified. [whispers] Whoever was behind that mask... has never been found.
